text: Of David. I I thank you, Lord, with all my heart; [AA]in the presence of the angels [1] to you I sing.
I bow low toward your holy temple;I praise your name for your mercy and faithfulness.For you have exalted over allyour name and your promise.
On the day I cried out, you answered;you strengthened my spirit.
II All the kings of earth will praise you, Lord,when they hear the words of your mouth.
They will sing of the ways of the Lord:"How great is the glory of the Lord!"
The Lord is on high, but cares for the lowly [AB]and knows the proud from afar.
Though I walk in the midst of dangers,you guard my life when my enemies rage.You stretch out your hand;your right hand saves me.
The Lord is with me to the end.Lord, your mercy endures forever.Never forsake the work of your hands!
